name: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems
subsector: missiles, air defence and weapon systems
desc: Israeli state-owned developer and maker of missile, air-defence, precision weapon and protection systems, including Iron Dome, David's Sling and Trophy.
products: Air and missile defence systems, precision-guided weapons, active protection, targeting pods (Litening, with Northrop Grumman), naval systems
customers: Israel Defense Forces and export governments (Germany and Finland cited)
markets: Israel and export defence customers in Europe, Asia and the Americas; joint ventures with Raytheon, Northrop Grumman and Singapore DSTA

access.roles: CEO; VP Marketing and Business Development; Government Companies Authority

compliance: Weapons maker owned by the Israeli state; reputational sensitivity for many rights holders and race promoters.

name: MBDA
desc: European missile and missile-defence systems maker jointly owned by Airbus, BAE Systems and Leonardo, supplying about 90 armed forces.

marketing_autonomy_basis: Trades under its own MBDA brand with its own CEO, website and newsroom
markets: France, UK, Italy, Germany, Spain and the US, exporting to about 90 armed forces worldwide

Created MILLIADES, a new electronic-engineering subsidiary in France
Partnership with Terma on air and surface defence

name: Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa (PGZ)
desc: Polish state-owned defence holding with 67 subsidiaries making armoured vehicles, air-defence systems, munitions, shipbuilding and electronics for the Polish armed forces.
products: Borsuk infantry fighting vehicle, Pilica and SAN air/anti-drone defence, MESKO munitions, naval shipyards, electronics
customers: Polish Ministry of National Defence; export customers
parent_immediate: State Treasury 71.36%, Polski Holding Obronny 14.82%, ARP 13.82%
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own PGZ group brand and website; state shareholder
stores_or_sites: Several dozen production plants, service facilities and research centres
markets: Poland primarily; partnerships with Anduril, Viasat and Eurenco (French-Polish JV)
profitability_basis: Net result PLN 1.68bn in 2024 (Polish Wikipedia table)

signals.what: Cooperation agreement with Anduril for local production of Barracuda-500M in Bydgoszcz
Letter of intent with Viasat on satellite communications and space capabilities
Eurenco and MESKO signed shareholders agreement for a French-Polish JV

fit_rationale: Fast-growing state defence holding riding Poland's rearmament with recruitment needs, but its market is the Polish state and there is no Polish Grand Prix; weak commercial case.
